after.d: One of the three doctors looks at your photos, confirms whether you are a candidate and chooses the treatment that fits. No salesperson in between.
Treatment, number of teeth and timeline from the doctor, with the written estimate at the published price. During office hours.
Your coordinator adds the two or three partners most likely to approve you, with example monthly payments. Checking eligibility does not affect your credit score.
Reserve your dates with a ${depositUsd} deposit when you are ready; it is applied to your treatment. One check-in from us, then no pressure.
